verdict.rationale: Ubuntu's own documentation includes a 'Navigate the interface using the keyboard' topic. Community reports describe moving windows with Win+Shift+arrow hotkeys and launching apps by typing in the Dash and pressing Enter. However, the evidence is only a doc title plus anecdotes, so whole-system keyboard operation is not shown in depth. missing for 10: a documented hotkey reference or customisable-shortcut docs, documented launcher/search behaviour in the current GNOME desktop, evidence that the entire system is keyboard-operable, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can operate the entire system using only the keyboard via hotkeys and a launcher
